formulas.F: T * sum(R1..R6) / 6; T=0 fixes F=0; otherwise required unresolved criteria keep F missing
formulas.leave_one_out: Delta_C,-b = sum(g_a for a in B_C except b)/(n_C-1); undefined for n_C<2
formulas.missing_bounds: sum(l_K1-u_K0)/(3*r_C) through sum(u_K1-l_K0)/(3*r_C); missing F has [l,u]=[0,1]
formulas.static_density: S=100*D/L; undefined for L=0 or incomplete analysis

denominator_rules: Primary core uses complete six-F blocks B_C and actual n_C.
Supplementary module pairs use their own complete-pair block sets and n_m.
Exploratory reference C-SQL-1 uses only first planned r_E blocks B_E; F contrasts use complete quartets n_EM/n_EP.
Every other metric uses its own observed population.
Missing-value bounds use all planned core runs and planned denominator 3*r_C.
Static analysis ratio uses actually sealed candidates, with separate valid D/L/S counts.
reporting_constraints: No inferential test, p-value, bootstrap or confidence interval.
No automatic acceptance/rejection of H-K and no interpretation of observed numeric direction.
Preserve observations, hashes, selected revisions, missing statuses and exact values.
Do not count shared C-SQL-1 reference twice as a new independent migration.
Do not add overlapping cache/reasoning token categories to total tokens.
Raw test fraction is passed/planned cases; show technical gaps separately.
No zero imputation for absent measurements or billing.

T_criteria.T5: Erlaubte Anwendungsdateien und unveränderte gemeinsame Voraussetzungen

display_rules: Show individual observations before summaries; no invisible observations behind boxes.
Identify whether each mark is a run value, paired difference, or block mean.
Every table and figure states its research question, purpose, reading instructions and limitations.
No change to frozen computation, observed values or research-plan estimands.
